top_categories.workout_context: 188 miles across 3 consecutive days. Train the repeatable power that still exists after yesterday's ride is in your legs.
Kindling's changing Scottish gravel rewards traction, cadence, and power control that stay reliable across 3 days.
Back-to-back race simulations rehearse Kindling's real problem: perform, recover overnight, then perform again.
Aerobic efficiency covers the untimed transfers without stealing the power reserved for timed stages across 3 days.
Timed stages surge above threshold, then demand recovery while you keep moving. Over-unders train that pattern for both Kindling's days.
The clock runs on selected stages at Kindling. Build repeatable threshold power without racing the transfers between them.
Multi-day volume builds the aerobic base to cover 188 total miles without turning every transfer into recovery debt.
Climbing must be repeatable across 3 days. Switch cadence and position without burning matches you need tomorrow.
Timed stages reward repeated high power, including on day 3. VO2 work keeps the final hard segment from becoming damage control.
Sustainable 88–92% FTP gives you hard, controlled speed on timed segments without emptying day 3's legs on day one.
Endurance with controlled intensity spikes matches a stage event: ride the transfers, race the segments, repeat for 3 days.
Decisive timed segments live just above sustainable power. Train how long you can stay there and how quickly you can reset for the next one.

race_overlay.heat: April in Graaff-Reinet, Eastern Cape, South Africa can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Kindling. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–70g carbs/hour on each of Kindling's 3 event days. Begin recovery fueling within 30 minutes of every finish, replace fluid and sodium, then eat a full carbohydrate-forward meal. Tomorrow's legs are built the night before.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Kindling requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on karoo stage-race gravel to build confidence. Expect: great karoo gravel roads, long open climbs, remote farm tracks.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Gravel Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 188 miles of karoo stage-race gravel across 3 consecutive days in Graaff-Reinet, Eastern Cape, South Africa.
